note: Frozen targets (estimates from general acoustics, written before anything was rendered). Do not edit during the run.

core.name: footstep_concrete
core.must_show: heel then toe: 2 onsets 60-150 ms apart; attack under 10 ms; centroid 0.8-3 kHz

core.name: footstep_gravel
core.must_show: 8 or more onsets; high flatness; centroid 2-6 kHz

core.name: footstep_grass
core.must_show: soft attack 10-40 ms; no pitch; centroid 1.5-5 kHz

core.name: footstep_wood_floor
core.must_show: a low body mode 80-300 Hz under a short tick

core.name: door_creak_open
core.must_show: pitched stick-slip between 200 and 1500 Hz whose pitch moves; no impact

core.name: door_slam
core.must_show: latch click, then a body under 150 Hz; attack under 5 ms

core.name: knock_wood
core.must_show: 3 onsets 0.15-0.3 s apart; modes 200-1200 Hz; each under 150 ms

core.name: glass_break
core.must_show: one hit, then 15 or more shard onsets thinning out; centroid over 4 kHz

core.name: glass_clink
core.must_show: inharmonic modes 1.5-6 kHz; smooth decay; one onset

core.name: metal_pipe_drop
core.must_show: 2-5 onsets with shrinking gaps; inharmonic ringing modes; decay over 0.5 s

core.name: coin_drop
core.must_show: 4 or more bounces with shrinking gaps; modes 3-9 kHz

core.name: water_drip
core.must_show: 1-3 drips, each 30-120 ms, pitch 600-2500 Hz rising within the drip

core.name: stream_loop
core.must_show: loop_seam passes; dense bubble onsets; energy 300 Hz-6 kHz

core.name: splash
core.must_show: broadband burst, then a bubbling tail; centroid falls over time

core.name: rain_loop
core.must_show: loop_seam passes; high flatness; centroid 3-8 kHz; steady level

core.name: wind_loop
core.must_show: loop_seam passes; centroid 200-1200 Hz and moving; loudness swings; no clicks

core.name: fire_loop
core.must_show: loop_seam passes; 5 or more crackles a second over a roar under 300 Hz and a hiss

core.name: thunder_distant
core.must_show: silence first; centroid under 150 Hz; long decay

core.name: cloth_rustle
core.must_show: 2-4 soft swells; no pitch; centroid 2-7 kHz; no hard onset

core.name: paper_crumple
core.must_show: dense crackle (20 or more onsets); centroid 3-8 kHz

core.name: sword_whoosh
core.must_show: swell in over 50-150 ms; centroid rises then falls; no click

core.name: punch_thud
core.must_show: attack under 5 ms; most energy under 200 Hz; a short slap at 1-4 kHz

core.name: switch_click
core.must_show: 1-2 onsets; centroid 2-6 kHz; ends clean

core.name: keys_jingle
core.must_show: 8 or more onsets; inharmonic modes 3-10 kHz

r2.name: chain_rattle
r2.must_show: 10 or more metallic onsets, clustered, modes 2-8 kHz

r2.name: zipper
r2.must_show: a steady fast onset train rising in rate then pitch; centroid 3-8 kHz

r2.name: pencil_scribble
r2.must_show: filtered noise strokes; 4 or more swells; centroid 3-9 kHz; no pitch

r2.name: drawer_slide
r2.must_show: low rumble 80-400 Hz rising then falling, with a soft wooden stop at the end

r3.name: rock_debris
r3.must_show: a heavy hit then 10 or more clicks thinning out; centroid 1-5 kHz

r3.name: ice_in_glass
r3.must_show: 2-4 clinks, modes 1.5-5 kHz, with a short crackle

r3.name: boiling_loop
r3.must_show: loop_seam passes; dense bubble onsets; energy 200 Hz-4 kHz

r3.name: rope_creak
r3.must_show: pitched stick-slip 150-900 Hz, fiber noise, no impact

r4.name: book_drop
r4.must_show: flat slap then low thud; attack under 5 ms; centroid 0.3-2 kHz

r4.name: match_strike
r4.must_show: scrape then a whoosh flare then faint crackle; centroid 2-7 kHz

r4.name: typewriter_key
r4.must_show: key strike then a metallic ring; 2-3 onsets under 100 ms apart

r4.name: car_door
r4.must_show: latch click then a dull thump with a body 80-250 Hz

r5.name: arrow_twang
r5.must_show: pitched string decay 100-400 Hz with a hit; one onset

r5.name: heartbeat_loop
r5.must_show: loop_seam passes; 2 low thumps per beat (lub-dub) under 150 Hz; 60-80 bpm

r5.name: bike_bell
r5.must_show: inharmonic metal modes 1.5-6 kHz, 2 rings, decay over 0.6 s

r5.name: squeaky_hinge
r5.must_show: pitched squeak 800-3000 Hz with pitch moving; no impact
